answer: Graders are audited with planted honeypots: answers engineered to look valid to a lenient judge and to be obviously worthless to a careful one, so a grader who approves them is exposed without any honest agent having to sacrifice a real answer. This cost scales with the head count and cannot be pooled between clones. The copper is the planted junk, the harbor the exposure it triggers, and the canyon the seat draw the exposed grader loses; a farm can spam the copper freely, but every copper it rewards costs it a canyon, and the harbor is the record that proves it.
